subject: DI04019011

h.en: 6.1.1 The condenser completes the steam heat-rejection path
h.gu: 6.1.1 Condenser Steamનું Heat-rejection Path પૂરું કરે

body.en:
Start with the situation

A turbine exhaust enters a condenser; heat moves to cooling water and finally to the environment, possibly through a cooling tower.

Definition / principle

A steam condenser removes heat to condense exhaust steam at the intended pressure. It can support low turbine back-pressure and condensate recovery depending on the arrangement.

Understand why

A cooling tower cools circulating water by air contact, mainly evaporation plus sensible transfer; it is not the same device as the steam condenser.

Application / illustration

Surface-condensing plants can recover clean condensate while cooling water circulates separately.

Common mistake / conditions

A condenser vacuum is not proof that there is no air leakage; partial pressures and removal capacity matter.

Is drift just water vapour?

No. Drift is entrained liquid droplets; evaporation produces vapour.
body.gu:
પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત

Turbine exhaust condenserમાં આવે;heat cooling waterમાં,પછી કદાચ cooling towerથી environmentમાં જાય.

Definition / Principle

Steam condenser exhaust steamનું heat કાઢી intended pressure પર condense કરે.Arrangement મુજબ low turbine back-pressure,condensate recoveryમાં મદદ કરે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Cooling tower air contactથી circulating water cool કરે,મુખ્ય evaporation,sensible transferથી;તે steam condenser નથી.

Application / ઉદાહરણ

Surface-condensing plantમાં cooling water અલગ circulate થતાં clean condensate recover થઈ શકે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Condenser vacuum એટલે air leakage નથી એવો પુરાવો નહિ;partial pressures,removal capacity મહત્વનાં છે.

Drift ફક્ત Water Vapour છે?

ના.Drift liquid droplets છે;evaporationથી vapour બને.

body.en:
Understand why

Functions:reject steam latent heat, maintain specified exhaust conditions, collect condensate and remove non-condensable gases through a dedicated system.

Direct-contact/jet condensers mix steam and cooling water; surface condensers separate them by tube walls. Jet arrangements may be parallel/counterflow or use an ejector/barometric arrangement as specified.

Common mistake / conditions

Steam condensate and cooling-water purity requirements determine whether mixing is acceptable. Not every vacuum arrangement uses the same pump/height.
body.gu:
કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Functions:steam latent heat reject,specified exhaust conditions રાખવા,condensate collect,dedicated systemથી non-condensables કાઢવા.

Direct-contact/jetમાં steam,cooling water mix થાય;surfaceમાં tube walls જુદા રાખે.Jetમાં specified parallel/counterflow,ejector/barometric arrangement હોઈ શકે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Condensate,cooling-water purityથી mixing acceptable છે કે નહિ નક્કી થાય.દરેક vacuum arrangementમાં same pump/height નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Cooling water contacts steam directly; heat transfer condenses steam into a mixed outlet stream.

Construction:part and purpose

A chamber receives steam through a designated inlet.

Sprays/trays distribute cooling water for contact.

A mixed-water outlet/hotwell collects the combined liquid.

A vent/air-removal system handles non-condensable gases.

Pumps/barometric leg as designed manage water discharge under pressure conditions.

Working:flow and reason

Steam and water enter in the specified relative directions.

Direct contact transfers heat and steam condenses.

Water flow and inlet temperature limit achievable condensation pressure/duty.

Mixed liquid leaves through the discharge system; non-condensables are separately removed.

Common mistake / conditions

Mixed condensate quality follows cooling-water quality; it is not automatically suitable as boiler feed without assessment/treatment.

Does high back-pressure prove air leakage?

No. Check cooling-water temperature/flow, fouling, load and instruments too.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Cooling water steamને direct contact કરે;heat transferથી steam mixed outletમાં condense થાય.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Chamber designated inletથી steam લે.

Sprays/trays water contact માટે distribute કરે.

Mixed-water outlet/hotwell combined liquid લે.

Vent/air-removal non-condensables કાઢે.

Designed pumps/barometric leg pressure conditionsમાં discharge સંભાળે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Steam,water specified relative directionsમાં આવે.

Direct contactમાં heat જાય,steam condense થાય.

Water flow,inlet temperature achievable pressure/duty limit કરે.

Mixed liquid dischargeમાં,non-condensables અલગ removalમાં જાય.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Mixed condensate quality cooling water મુજબ;assessment/treatment વગર boiler feed માટે automatic suitable નહિ.

High Back-pressureથી Air Leakage સાબિત?

ના.Water temperature/flow,fouling,load,instruments પણ જુઓ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Steam condenses on the outside of cooling-water tubes without intended mixing; condensate and cooling water have separate paths.

Construction:part and purpose

A shell encloses the steam space and tube bundle.

Tube sheets, water boxes and passes direct cooling water.

Steam inlet and a hotwell collect separated condensate.

Air-cooling/removal zones connect to ejectors/vacuum pumps as designed.

Condensate extraction and cooling-water systems maintain flow/level.

Working:flow and reason

Cooling water flows inside tubes under the specified water-side conditions.

Exhaust steam surrounds the tubes and releases latent heat.

Condensate drains to the hotwell and is extracted.

Non-condensables accumulate in designated regions and are removed.

Cooling water carries heat to a heat sink/tower; wall/tube integrity prevents contamination.

Common mistake / conditions

Tube leaks can contaminate condensate; fouling and poor air removal raise pressure and reduce performance.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Intended mixing વગર cooling-water tubesની બહાર steam condense થાય;condensate,waterના paths અલગ.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Shell steam space,tube bundle ધરાવે.

Tube sheets,water boxes,passes cooling water guide કરે.

Steam inlet,hotwell separated condensate લે.

Designed air-cooling/removal zones ejectors/vacuum pumps સાથે જોડાય.

Condensate extraction,cooling-water systems flow/level રાખે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Cooling water specified conditionsમાં tubesની અંદર જાય.

Exhaust steam tubesને ઘેરી latent heat છોડે.

Condensate hotwellમાં drain થઈ extract થાય.

Non-condensables designated regionsમાં ભેગા થઈ દૂર થાય.

Cooling water heat sink/towerમાં heat લઈ જાય;wall/tube integrity contamination અટકાવે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Tube leaks condensate contaminate કરે;fouling,poor air removal pressure વધારી performance ઘટાડે.

body.en:
Given and model

Steam flow2kg/s; hin2400, hcond200kJ/kg; cooling water25→35°C, cp4.18kJ/kgK; steady no external loss.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Qdot=2(2400−200)=4400kW
  2. mdot water=4400/[4.18(35−25)]=105.263kg/s

Common mistake / conditions

Steam-side enthalpy drop may include wetness/subcooling as given; do not assume a universal latent heat irrespective of pressure.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Steam flow2kg/s;hin2400,hcond200kJ/kg;cooling water25→35°C,cp4.18kJ/kgK;steady,no external loss.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Qdot=2(2400−200)=4400kW
  2. mdot water=4400/[4.18(35−25)]=105.263kg/s

Common Mistake / શરતો

Given steam-side enthalpy dropમાં wetness/subcooling હોઈ શકે;pressure વગર universal latent heat ન માનો.

h.en: 6.1.6 Air leakage:why a little gas matters
h.gu: 6.1.6 Air Leakage:થોડો Gas પણ કેમ અસર કરે?

body.en:
Definition / principle

In the ideal-gas mixture approximation, total pressure is steam partial pressure plus non-condensable partial pressures. Air leakage can raise condenser pressure and create diffusion/thermal resistance near condensing surfaces.

Understand why

Effects can include higher turbine back-pressure, less heat transfer, greater air-removal load and oxygen-related corrosion risk. Signals must be interpreted with cooling-water temperature, fouling, load and instrument accuracy.

Common mistake / conditions

Do not diagnose every high back-pressure as a leak; insufficient cooling water or warmer inlet water can give similar symptoms.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Ideal-gas mixture approximationમાં total pressure=steam partial pressure+non-condensable partial pressures.Air leakage condenser pressure વધારે,condensing surfaces પાસે diffusion/thermal resistance બનાવે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Higher turbine back-pressure,less heat transfer,greater air-removal load,oxygen-related corrosion risk થાય.Signalsમાં water temperature,fouling,load,instrument accuracy પણ જુઓ.

Common Mistake / શરતો

દરેક high back-pressureને leak ન કહો;ઓછું cooling water કે warmer inletથી પણ આવું થાય.

body.en:
Step-by-step solution

  1. Check instruments, load, cooling-water conditions and air-removal equipment before declaring leakage.
  2. Inspect accessible seals, joints, valves and gland systems using approved safe methods.
  3. Qualified tracer-gas/helium detection or ultrasonic methods may help locate leakage where suitable; isolation/pressure-rise tests require an authorised procedure and safe plant state.
  4. Record evidence and verify the repair/condition through the approved process.

Common mistake / conditions

Do not apply flammable sprays, open flames, unsafe pressurisation or improvised isolation to a running vacuum/steam system.
body.gu:
Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Leakage પહેલાં instruments,load,water conditions,air-removal equipment તપાસો.
  2. Approved safe methodsથી accessible seals,joints,valves,gland systems જુઓ.
  3. Suitable હોય ત્યાં qualified tracer-gas/helium,ultrasonic methods મદદ કરે;isolation/pressure-rise testsમાં authorised procedure,safe plant state જોઈએ.
  4. Evidence નોંધો,approved processથી repair/condition verify કરો.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Running vacuum/steam system પર flammable sprays,open flames,unsafe pressurisation,improvised isolation ન કરો.

body.en:
Understand why

Classify by draft(natural/mechanical), mechanical fan position(forced/induced), flow(counterflow/crossflow), circuit(open/closed) and heat-rejection mode(wet/dry/hybrid).

Wet-tower range=hot-water inlet−cold-water outlet. Approach=cold-water outlet−inlet-air wet-bulb temperature. Tower effectiveness=(range)/(range+approach) under the stated convention.

Common mistake / conditions

Inlet wet-bulb temperature, not dry-bulb alone, sets the ideal evaporative cooling reference; real towers need a positive design approach.
body.gu:
કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Draft(natural/mechanical),fan position(forced/induced),flow(counterflow/crossflow),circuit(open/closed),heat-rejection mode(wet/dry/hybrid)થી classify કરો.

Wet-tower range=hot-water inlet−cold-water outlet.Approach=cold-water outlet−inlet-air wet-bulb temperature.Stated conventionમાં effectiveness=range/(range+approach).

Common Mistake / શરતો

Ideal evaporative cooling reference inlet wet-bulb છે,ફક્ત dry-bulb નહિ;real towersમાં positive design approach જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A downstream fan draws air through distributed warm water/fill; evaporation and sensible transfer cool the circulating water.

Construction:part and purpose

Water distribution/nozzles spread hot circulating water.

Fill increases effective contact area and contact time.

Air inlets/louvres admit air in the selected flow arrangement.

A top/outlet fan induces flow; drift eliminators reduce entrained droplet escape.

Basin, pump, make-up and blowdown/water-treatment systems maintain the circuit.

Working:flow and reason

Hot water enters distribution and falls over fill.

Fan draws air through/against falling water according to cross/counterflow design.

A small fraction evaporates, removing latent heat from the remaining water.

Cooled water collects in basin and returns to the condenser/process.

Make-up replaces evaporation, drift and blowdown; chemistry/biological control require qualified management.

Common mistake / conditions

Drift is liquid droplets, not evaporated vapour; visible plume alone is not proof of high drift. Approved water hygiene and fan safety are essential.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Downstream fan distributed warm water/fillમાંથી air ખેંચે;evaporation,sensible transfer water cool કરે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Water distribution/nozzles hot water ફેલાવે.

Fill effective area,contact time વધારે.

Air inlets/louvres selected arrangementમાં air લે.

Top/outlet fan flow ખેંચે;drift eliminators droplet escape ઘટાડે.

Basin,pump,make-up,blowdown/water-treatment circuit જાળવે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Hot water distributionમાં આવી fill પર પડે.

Cross/counterflow designમાં fan airને falling waterમાંથી/વિરુદ્ધ ખેંચે.

નાનો fraction evaporate થઈ બાકીના waterમાંથી latent heat લે.

Cooled water basinમાં collect થઈ condenser/processમાં જાય.

Make-up evaporation,drift,blowdown replace કરે;chemistry/biological controlમાં qualified management જોઈએ.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Drift liquid droplets છે,evaporated vapour નહિ;visible plumeથી high drift સાબિત નહિ.Approved water hygiene,fan safety જરૂરી.

h.en: 6.2.3 Natural draft, forced draft and closed circuits
h.gu: 6.2.3 Natural Draft,Forced Draft અને Closed Circuits

body.en:
Understand why

Natural-draft towers use density/buoyancy over a large height; mechanical fans are absent for that main draft. Forced-draft fans push air in at the inlet; induced fans pull from the outlet.

In a closed-circuit evaporative tower, the process fluid remains inside a coil while an external spray/air circuit removes heat. Dry coolers reject heat through surfaces without the same intentional evaporation.

Common mistake / conditions

Open/closed circuit describes fluid separation, not automatically whether a fan is used or whether evaporation occurs.
body.gu:
કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Natural-draftમાં મોટી height પર density/buoyancyથી main draft મળે,એ માટે mechanical fans નહિ.Forced-draft fans inletથી push;induced outletથી pull કરે.

Closed-circuit evaporative towerમાં process fluid coilમાં રહે;external spray/air heat કાઢે.Dry coolers surfacesથી heat કાઢે,same intentional evaporation વગર.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Open/closed circuit fluid separation બતાવે;fan છે કે evaporation થાય એ આપમેળે નહિ.

body.en:
Given and model

Water40→30°C, inlet-air wet bulb25°C; use the stated wet-tower effectiveness convention.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Range=40−30=10°C; approach=30−25=5°C
  2. Effectiveness=10/(10+5)=.666667=66.6667%

Common mistake / conditions

This is a temperature-performance index, not thermal-engine efficiency or the fraction of all water evaporated.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Water40→30°C,inlet-air wet bulb25°C;stated wet-tower effectiveness convention લો.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Range=40−30=10°C;approach=30−25=5°C
  2. Effectiveness=10/(10+5)=.666667=66.6667%

Common Mistake / શરતો

આ temperature-performance index છે,thermal-engine efficiency કે કુલ waterનો evaporated fraction નહિ.

body.en:
Write a strong exam answer

  1. Compare condenser type by condensate purity, water availability, vacuum duty, maintenance, space and cost. Draw separate steam/condensate/water/air paths.
  2. Tower answer:classify, draw fill/fan/water distribution/eliminator/basin, explain evaporation, define wet bulb/range/approach, then discuss water quality, drift, noise, energy and climate constraints.
Can a cooling tower operate with zero make-up forever?

Not a wet evaporative circuit with ongoing evaporation/drift/blowdown; mass losses must be replaced.
body.gu:
Exam Answer મજબૂત ગોઠવીએ

  1. Condensate purity,water availability,vacuum duty,maintenance,space,costથી condenser compare કરો.Steam/condensate/water/air paths અલગ દોરો.
  2. Tower answer:classify,fill/fan/distribution/eliminator/basin દોરો,evaporation સમજાવો,wet bulb/range/approach define કરો,પછી water quality,drift,noise,energy,climate limits.
Tower Zero Make-upથી હંમેશાં ચાલે?

સતત evaporation/drift/blowdownવાળી wet circuitમાં નહિ;mass losses replace કરવા પડે.
